data.description: The primary data of the document

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource

meta.description: Non-standard meta information about the resource

rank.description: Rank of the recommended contact (1-based, lower is better). Contacts are ordered from most to least relevant.

score.description: Similarity score between the reference person and the recommended contact. Higher values indicate greater similarity. Due to the nature of vector store similarity calculations, values may occasionally exceed 1.0.

reRankingScore.description: Re-ranking score of the recommended contact, produced by a machine learning model applied after initial retrieval to refine relevancy using propensity signals (contact similarity, quality, title boosting, etc.). Higher values indicate greater relevancy. Returns -1.0 when the ML reranking model did not run.

recommendedPersonBrief.description: Brief description of the recommended contact's profile, used to explain why this person was recommended. Absent when profile data is unavailable.

ContactRecommendationAttributes.description: Attributes for a contact recommendation entity.

sourceType.description: Source interaction type used to generate this recommendation, such as copied, exported, viewed, or CRM closed-won contacts.

referencePersonId.description: Unique identifier for a reference person (ZoomInfo Person ID). A reference person is someone the salesperson has interacted with through the ZoomInfo platform (e.g. copy, export, view) or a contact found in the tenant's CRM from past closed-won deals.

referencePersonBrief.description: Brief description of the reference person's profile that was used to generate this recommendation.

ExplainabilityMetadata.description: Explainability metadata for a contact recommendation.

SourceType.description: Source interaction type used to generate contact recommendations.

x-enumDescriptions.AMPLITUDE_COPIED_CONTACTS: Contacts copied from ZoomInfo during prospecting.
x-enumDescriptions.AMPLITUDE_EXPORTED_CONTACTS: Contacts exported from ZoomInfo in bulk.
x-enumDescriptions.AMPLITUDE_VIEWED_CONTACTS: Contacts viewed via contact card/profile in ZoomInfo.
x-enumDescriptions.CRM_CLOSED_WON_ENGAGED_CONTACTS: Contacts that were engaged with in closed-won deals in the user's CRM.
x-enumDescriptions.CRM_CLOSED_WON_CONTACTS: Contacts recorded as connected to successful (closed-won) deals in the user's CRM.
x-enumDescriptions.COLD_START_CONTACTS: Contacts of interest for new users or cold-start scenarios where there is limited interaction history.
